meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划配置计算流体动力学仿真，进行数值有效性与HPC安全检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做流体动力学仿真，需要确保计算参数有效
copy.tagline_en: Plan, configure, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations with validity and HPC safety checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you conduct fluid dynamics simulations and need to ensure numerical validity and HPC safety

howto.what: 当你处理流体仿真任务时,Claude 会基于 FluidSim(Python 计算流体动力学框架)帮你规划、配置、检查、重启并分析仿真,同时做数值有效性和 HPC 安全检验。支持 2D/3D 纳维-斯托克斯、浅水、分层流等求解器。
howto.when: 当你想运行流体仿真(如涉及纳维-斯托克斯方程、浅水方程、分层流),或要分析湍流、涡动力学、地球物理流时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 ns2d 求解器配置一个二维湍流仿真,输出涡量图。
say.note: 会生成参数配置与运行脚本。

say.text: 检查这个流场参数是否满足数值稳定性要求,并给出建议。
把这个 3D 仿真改用 MPI 并行运行,写完整脚本。
say.note: 生成带 mpirun 的执行方案。

howto.what_en: When you work on fluid simulations, Claude plans, configures, inspects, restarts, and analyzes FluidSim CFD simulations with numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Supports Navier-Stokes, shallow water, stratified flow solvers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run fluid dynamics simulations (Navier-Stokes 2D/3D, shallow water, stratified flows) or analyze turbulence, vortex dynamics, or geophysical flows.

say_en.text: Configure a 2D turbulence simulation with ns2d and plot vorticity.
Check if these flow parameters satisfy numerical stability and suggest fixes.
Rewrite this 3D simulation for MPI parallel execution.
